newsitem.title: ITALY: BancaRoma, BNA confirm talks on Interbanca ITPI.
newsitem.headline: BancaRoma, BNA confirm talks on Interbanca ITPI.

text.p: Banca di Roma and Banca Nazionale dell'Agricoltura (BNA) confirmed that Banca Antoniana Popolare Veneta had expressed interest in taking control of Italian merchant bank Interbanca.
Milan-based Interbanca is controlled by the Banca di Roma group through its BNA subsidiary.

The two banks said in a joint statement confirming press reports that the Venice regional bank was also interested in taking over between 50 and 75 branches of the Cassa di Risparmio di Roma savings bank group.
They said they had informed Banca Antoniana of their readiness to enter negotiations.
